output.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_order_count FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE status = 'open';
output.explanation: This assumes an order is "open" when its status is 'open'. The schema doesn't document the allowed values of marts.fct_orders.status, so this literal is a guess. Before relying on the number, run SELECT DISTINCT status FROM marts.fct_orders to confirm the correct status value(s) for open orders (for example, if the warehouse uses 'pending' or 'processing' instead).
